rule.description: A production statement region is permanently unreachable at runtime because the only control path into it is guarded by a predicate that folds to a compile-time boolean constant false (or, for else arms and non-matching cases, that never selects them). Recognized shapes: an if whose condition constant-folds to false; the else arm of an if whose condition constant-folds to true; a switch case whose constant value can never equal the constant switch tag; a for whose condition constant-folds to false.

checks.description: Detect statement regions whose only entry is a control predicate that folds to a compile-time constant that never selects them.
checks.detected_relation: guarded statement region -> control predicate with compile-time constant value that makes the region unreachable
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Code that no supported configuration can ever execute is dead code: it still has to be read, reasoned about and carried through every future edit of the containing pipeline phase, although no runtime, registration or configuration path can reach it.

matches.evidence: The then-branch of `if experimentalVerboseEval && stage.isShortCircuitable()` is unreachable: experimentalVerboseEval is a package const false, so the conjunction folds to false for every stage. The branch reads as a data-dependent evaluation guard but cannot run in any build.

The then-branch of `if experimentalOpStage` is unreachable: experimentalOpStage is a package const false, so every operator symbol falls straight through to the real type-check switch; the experimental float type-check return can never be taken.

The `case "mysql":` arm of `switch experimentalDialectKind` can never be selected because experimentalDialectKind is a package const with the value "ansi"; the MySQL-specific rendering assignment is permanently unreachable.

measurement.predicate_form: constant switch tag, non-matching case value

matches.evidence: The `case "postgres":` arm of the same constant-tagged switch can never be selected for the same reason; the PostgreSQL-specific rendering assignment is permanently unreachable.

measurement.predicate_form: constant switch tag, non-matching case value

matches.evidence: The then-branch of `if !legacyDiagnosticSanitizer` is unreachable: legacyDiagnosticSanitizer is a package const true, so its negation folds to false; the experimental first-rune validation diagnostics never run for any candidate string during accessor checking.

The then-branch of `if experimentalBigNumCoercion` is unreachable: experimentalBigNumCoercion is a package const false, so the experimental big-number coercion path never runs; only the else arm (the original pass-through return that non-numeric parameters depend on) executes.

measurement.predicate_form: named const false, live else arm

excluded.candidate: Runtime-predicate branches throughout the pipeline (e.g., the isShortCircuitable switch, type-sensitive string/float comparisons in stage operators, token-kind dispatches)
excluded.reason: Their conditions are runtime values, not compile-time constants; whatever their reachability profile, they are outside the constant-false reachability relation this rule credits.
